R14-accumulator.reviewed_assertions: Concurrent mixed producer updates retain every expected reason and unsuccessful status with shared progress null and present; a clean accumulator succeeds. Deterministic barriers reorder successful/failing producers; bounded exact counters/reason snapshots do not lose updates. Distinct outcomes are asserted through results, not stderr.

R14-parse-read.reviewed_assertions: Use a rejecting DatabaseInterface with separate size-read and payload-read failures, an absent required shader/dependency, invalid JSON, unsupported serialization version E7 {"version":999}, mismatched tag/hash and parse-with-no-acknowledgement. Assert appropriate read/missing vs parse outcomes and known identities; successful parse control has no failure. E7 never succeeds just because parse-only queue drained.

R14-vulkan-create.reviewed_assertions: For graphics, compute and raytracing, inject at least VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY and VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST through actual production creation calls; assert creation-failed outcome, exact raw value/tag/hash, nonzero aggregate, null outputs and cleanup. Add shader-module and initial-object creation rejection controls so these cannot disappear through callback true/parse success. Successful creation remains zero and preserves outputs/lifetimes.

R14-compile-required-loop.reviewed_assertions: For every pipeline kind assert compile-required then success fallback yields success; compile-required then failure and explicit skip retain unsuccessful required work; successful fallback is not a driver crash. Check loop_count>1 success and failure-then-success: prior unrecovered required iteration failure remains visible. Verify create/destroy counts and counters remain meaningful.

R14-support.reviewed_assertions: Deterministically unsupported shader and graphics/compute/raytracing pipeline create-info produce unsupported, not validation/driver-crash, outcome even when progress is absent. Selected unsupported work returns nonzero; valid support control succeeds. Test a support rejection in a main-thread initial object callback as well as worker setup.

R14-validation.location: test/replay_outcome_test.cpp (new private production-inclusion target); test/replay_outcome_cli.cmake and test/replay_outcome_compatibility_test.cpp (new or equivalent committed registered fixtures)
R14-validation.reviewed_assertions: Invalid SPIR-V with FOSSILIZE_REPLAYER_SPIRV_VAL ON and --spirv-val uses the real validator and records validation-failed; a valid minimal shader control succeeds. Trigger actual on_validation_error callback during shader/pipeline creation via a deterministic dispatch adapter; retain validation failure even when Vulkan returns VK_SUCCESS. Blocked downstream pipelines are dependency failures, not their own compiler crashes.

R14-setup-dependency.reviewed_assertions: Null/invalid setup create info, missing base pipeline, missing shader module and missing graphics/raytracing library dependencies retain setup or dependency-blocked as appropriate; do not dereference null create info or call Vulkan for blocked work. Include missing out-of-range library/dependency and required initial-object failure. Controlled run/device setup failure has unknown item identity and nonzero aggregate. Every failure has a valid-control counterpart.

R14-worker-queue.reviewed_assertions: Run actual worker threads over fixed mixed parse/create jobs using one and multiple threads, both memory contexts, successful and failed processing, and shared progress null/present. Assert queued_count==completed_count==the exact submitted work count in every drained context; retained result remains unsuccessful. Include a completely successful queued workload returning zero. Use barriers/watchdogs, no random instability or timing sleeps.

R14-real-cli.location: test/replay_outcome_cli.cmake and test/replay_outcome_compatibility_test.cpp (new or equivalent committed registered fixtures)
R14-real-cli.reviewed_assertions: Generate verified FOZ fixtures, read them back to establish known tag/hash/payload; invoke shipped fossilize-replay --null-device for E7, missing input hash/dependency, unsupported required work, real SPIR-V validation failure, a fixed mixed valid/invalid archive, fully valid nonempty workload and empty archive. Assert real numeric process status (nonzero failures, zero controls) and direct ExternalReplayer wait/status behavior. Test creation/setup failures through a private executable invoking the same production main/run path with only the Vulkan/database adapter replaced; it must not set the accumulator directly.

R14-mode-matrix.location: test/replay_outcome_test.cpp (new private production-inclusion target); test/replay_outcome_cli.cmake and test/replay_outcome_compatibility_test.cpp (new or equivalent committed registered fixtures)
R14-mode-matrix.reviewed_assertions: Replay the same fixed mixed workload in normal replay, direct child, child/controller and --progress modes. Cover one/multiple worker threads or controller children and optional shared progress absent/present where supported; impossible CLI combinations use private production-entry fixtures and are documented, not silently omitted. Assert identical expected logical unsuccessful result/reason set, zero for matching clean controls, all orderly assigned work drained, and exact expected queue completions independent of result. Reverse orderly child completion order with deterministic barriers and verify a successful sibling cannot mask failure. Any private adapters only inject producers; they do not replace result logic.

R14-controller-policy.location: test/replay_outcome_test.cpp (new private production-inclusion target); existing test/replay_controller_test.cpp
R14-controller-policy.reviewed_assertions: Directly inspect controller retained outcomes for orderly controlled item failure with another child successful in both completion orders: failed required items stay unsuccessful, no fake crash counters/restart loop, sibling completes, no shared progress dependency. Retain all #13 lost-before-progress, mixed order, clean, recovered-every-item, skipped culprit, unknown remainder and cleanup assertions. Full ring/drop/absent forwarding must not erase authoritative outcome.

R14-compatibility.location: test/replay_outcome_cli.cmake and test/replay_outcome_compatibility_test.cpp (new or equivalent committed registered fixtures); existing test/replay_controller_compatibility_test.cpp and test/diagnostic_compatibility_test.cpp
R14-compatibility.reviewed_assertions: Compile/run an old ExternalReplayer caller using declarations from base headers against candidate libraries, asserting wait, is_process_complete and cached status for successful and controlled failed work. Assert SharedControlBlock layout/version and existing progress/resume literal semantics stay unchanged. Preserve valid old CLI invocations, range/whitelist explicit selection behavior, null-device and successful compile-required fallback; document formerly false-success exits and any additive internal terminal protocol behavior. No general binary ABI or mixed-version process guarantee.

R14-original-defect.location: test/replay_outcome_cli.cmake and test/replay_outcome_compatibility_test.cpp (new or equivalent committed registered fixtures); existing test/replay_controller_cli.cmake
R14-original-defect.reviewed_assertions: Candidate fixture generator emits E7 plus clean control; run identical assertion-bearing CLI oracle against base and candidate normal/master/progress executables. Base is expected to exhibit the original zero exit on rejected work in Debug and Release; candidate must return nonzero. Controls return zero for both. Capture deliberate oracle rejection or explicit defect observation without treating an expected baseline failure as a candidate test failure. Existing #13 Release {} rejection expectation is changed to nonzero; Debug E5/E6 worker-loss assertions remain.

R14-scope-docs.reviewed_assertions: Candidate changelog has one short factual [Observability] sentence, practical replay false-success benefit and full #14 link. Verification documentation distinguishes internal outcomes, intentional exit/protocol changes, policy/exclusions and unverified Windows/hardware guarantees. No generated outputs or private machine configuration are tracked. Entire base-to-candidate diff is reviewed.
